title: Reference life tables and cross-country comparisons of years of life lost: malignant CNS neoplasms and lifespan variation in Europe (analysis code)
description:
Analysis code and derived data for a study of how far cross-country comparisons of years of life lost from malignant central nervous system neoplasms (ICD-10 C70-C72) in 28 European countries, 2012 to 2018, depend on the reference life table, and of how these deaths affect life expectancy and life disparity.

The pipeline combines Eurostat cause-of-death data with Human Mortality Database exposures, all-cause deaths and period life tables. It computes age-standardised mortality and years of life lost rates under national period life tables and two common references (the official GBD 2023 theoretical minimum risk life table and an empirical minimum-mortality table), rank agreement between the resulting country orderings, the same reference comparison for eight further causes, cause-deleted life tables giving the change in life expectancy at birth and in life disparity, numerically identified threshold ages, an exactly additive age decomposition of the life-disparity effect, and 95% Poisson perturbation intervals from 10,000 replicates.

Human Mortality Database source files are not redistributable and are not included; an authenticated retrieval script and a manifest of series vintages and SHA-256 digests are provided instead. RESULTS_SUMMARY.md records the design and every headline result.
